# Northline Ferries: Fare Payment Interoperability

Last updated 12 February 2026.

## What is accepted on board

Northline Ferries accepts the Meridian Card on all coastal routes. The card is tapped at
the gangway reader before boarding. Paper tickets remain available at every terminal.

There are 1.4 million active Meridian Cards in circulation as of 12 February 2026.

## Cross-border interoperability

The following partner schemes are live for cross-border tap-and-go on Northline services:
Calder Transit and Vantis Rail. No other scheme is live at this time.

An agreement with the Harbour Transit Authority was signed on 3 January 2026. Phased
technical work is scheduled through 2026. Harbour Transit is not on the live list.
